description: Semantic + keyword (hybrid) search over the original text of one or more Matrix contexts — the default tool for finding passages in the user's documents (regulations, legal norms, contracts, standards, manuals). Returns numbered chunks with stable chunk_id, header (document · outline path, e.g. chapter › article › paragraph, where headings are recognised), file and page where known, text and outgoing references to other norms (with the resolved target chunk_id when known) — cite sources by chunk_id (and file/page for the user). In this program each hit is an excerpt of about 300 characters that fits the query, not the whole passage, and hits of one article are merged into one entry with several chunk_ids and pages: quote and cite only what you read with get_chunks (whole article: get_section); detail "full" returns whole passages. get_section returns the whole article or section of a hit. Requires the context to have an embedding model (see list_contexts); otherwise use lookup_exact. Each chunk carries its language (ISO code; list_contexts lists the collection's). Search finds best in the language of the documents: if the question is in another language, also search with a translation into theirs. Narrow to mails of one sender, a date range or a folder with sender, date_from/date_to and folder (e.g. what X wrote in autumn 2001).

date_from.description: Optional: only documents dated on or after this day (mails: their own date), YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY; inclusive. Documents without a date are left out.

date_to.description: Optional: only documents dated on or before this day (mails: their own date), YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY; inclusive. Documents without a date are left out.

detail.description: snippets: per hit only the excerpt that fits the query (about 300 characters) with file, page and outline path, hits of one article merged - far fewer tokens; read the full text with get_chunks / get_section before you quote. full: the whole passage text per hit. Default: snippets in the stand-alone plugin program, full elsewhere.

document_ids.description: Optional: restrict to these documents (ids from list_documents); they must belong to the given contexts.

folder.description: Optional: only documents whose folder path in the collection contains this text, case-insensitive (e.g. "lay-k/sent"); "/inbox/" matches a whole folder name.

rerank_candidates.description: How many top hits the local reranker re-reads and puts first; further hits up to top_k follow in search order (default 20, max 200; only where a local reranker is active, i.e. the stand-alone plugin program). Raise it when the passage you look for is probably worded differently from your question (abbreviation, paraphrase): more candidates find it, but each adds search time.

sender.description: Optional: only mails (and their attachments) whose sender (From: name or address) contains this text, case-insensitive. Other documents are left out.

top_k.description: How many chunks to return (default: as many as fill one result, 15 whole passages with detail full or 85 snippets; at most 15 / 87).

name: search_context
